pig-avatar.description: Train PiG-Avatar on unified dataset subjects.
environment_check: import os, sys, torch, torchmetrics, torch_fidelity, runpy; target = os.path.join(sys.prefix, 'targets', 'x86_64-linux'); include = os.path.join(target, 'include'); library = os.path.join(target, 'lib'); os.environ.setdefault('CUDA_HOME', sys.prefix); os.environ['CPATH'] = include + (os.pathsep + os.environ['CPATH'] if os.environ.get('CPATH') else ''); os.environ['CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH'] = include + (os.pathsep + os.environ['CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH'] if os.environ.get('CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH') else ''); os.environ['LIBRARY_PATH'] = library + (os.pathsep + os.environ['LIBRARY_PATH'] if os.environ.get('LIBRARY_PATH') else ''); os.environ['LD_LIBRARY_PATH'] = library + (os.pathsep + os.environ['LD_LIBRARY_PATH'] if os.environ.get('LD_LIBRARY_PATH') else ''); assert torch.cuda.is_available(), 'CUDA is unavailable'; capability = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(); required = f'sm_{capability[0]}{capability[1]}'; supported = torch.cuda.get_arch_list(); assert required in supported, f'GPU requires {required}, but this PyTorch wheel supports only {supported}'; os.environ.setdefault('TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST', f'{capability[0]}.{capability[1]}'); torch.zeros(1, device='cuda'); runpy.run_path('../../scripts/diagnostics/check_pig_avatar_env.py', run_name='__main__')

mmlphuman.description: Run the external MMLP Human method through a manifest-backed THuman staging adapter.
environment_check: import gsplat, h5py, omegaconf, open3d, pytorch3d, torch; import sys; from pathlib import Path; assert Path("train.py").is_file(); assert (Path(sys.prefix) / "bin" / "PointInterpolant").is_file()

mmlphuman-lod.description: MMLPHuman with continuous nested Gaussian subsets and fraction-conditioned basis weights; original training configuration.
environment_check: import gsplat, h5py, omegaconf, open3d, pytorch3d, torch; import sys; from pathlib import Path; assert Path("train.py").is_file(); assert (Path(sys.prefix) / "bin" / "PointInterpolant").is_file()

animatable-gaussians.description: Run the external Animatable Gaussians method through a manifest-backed THuman staging adapter.
environment_check: import cv2, diff_gaussian_rasterization_depth_alpha, fused, posevocab_custom_ops, pytorch3d, root_finding, torch, upfirdn2d, yaml; from pathlib import Path; assert Path("main_avatar.py").is_file()
